The '''Dodgy Squire''' can be found at the [[Void Knights' Outpost]] and will refund 80% of the original value of [[commendation points]] in exchange for [[Void Knight equipment]] pieces, excluding the [[Void seal]]. He is located just north of the bank. He will not accept [[(broken)]] items, nor any of the [[Shattered relics void ornament kit|ornamented]] items. He will accept [[(l)|locked]] items, but the [[trouver parchment]] is '''not''' refunded, so it is recommended to unlock the item before refunding it.
